title: Companion disapproval is narrated as consequential ('Companions judge what you do... one pushed too far walks out'), but none of the disapprovals I triggered (Brother Osk over sealing the barrow, for instance) produced any visible warning, meter, or actual consequence for the rest of the playthrough.
where: Barrow Field, 'seal the barrow doors behind you' (Brother Osk disapproves)
